build_model_from_cfg: build a model architecture from a detectron2 config object using the registered meta-architecture
register_meta_architecture: register a new meta-architecture class in the META_ARCH_REGISTRY for model building
get_registered_meta_arch: get a registered meta-architecture constructor from META_ARCH_REGISTRY by name
build_model_with_device: build a model and move it to the specified torch device from config
log_meta_arch_usage: log API usage when a specific meta-architecture is instantiated via build_model
